title: Value premium by sector (hierarchical partial pooling)
description: Is the earnings-yield premium different across sectors? Sector-specific slopes shrunk toward the cross-sector mean by a Gibbs sampler.
question: factors
method_note: Varying intercepts and slopes by sector, beta_s ~ N(mu, tau^2), tau with a half-Cauchy prior; blocked Gibbs (4 chains) with split R-hat and ESS. Small or noisy sectors borrow strength from the rest; out of fold it is compared with one pooled OLS and per-sector OLS. Caveat: the universe is today's constituents (membership history starts 2026-10), so early years carry survivorship bias; read the premium as an upper bound.
expected_outputs: per-sector slopes: no / partial / complete pooling

result.verdict: partial pooling does not significantly beat linear-Gaussian baseline on CRPS (DM p = 0.869); point forecast: partial pooling does not significantly beat linear baseline (DM p = 0.387)

study.name: Value premium by sector (hierarchical partial pooling)
